title: Keep normal Pi prompts working when no goal is active
description: Regression fix: pi-goal must not abort ordinary provider requests when the session has no active goal. Add an adapter regression test and verify full checks.

logs.msg: Root cause: before_provider_request unconditionally called ctx.abort() when no active goal, which aborted every ordinary prompt. Fixed the guard to return when no goal or non-active goal; added regression coverage. Verification: bun test 28 passed / 60 expectations, bunx tsc --noEmit, git diff --check.
